notes: Both articleless attributive participles (מְשׁוֹבֶבֶת, מְקֻבֶּצֶת) take their supplied relative frames under rule 41's last paragraph rather than leaving the relatives added.
לָבֶטַח fuses to 'securely' under rule 30's one-English-word condition, headed on the noun; the same treatment recurs in vv. 11 and 14, which is chapter-consistent.
The resultative לְ of הָיוּ לְחָרְבָּה is unrepresented because היה holds 'have been' and no separate result word is written — rule 49's frame applies only where the clause is verbless.
One article morpheme in the verse (on הַשָּׁנִים) takes its chain's fronted 'the'; the other four written 'the's are supplied on anarthrous nominals or constructs.
